paragraphs: Yosef the fowler asked Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira: Chullin 54a. Levi came to his home; he brought him a peacock’s head in milk. Rabbi told Levi: ‘Why did you not excommunicate him?’ He replied: ‘It was Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira’s place, and I thought he had expounded to them that poultry is permitted in milk’: Chullin 116a. Shabbat 130a: Rabbi Ammi told Levi, ‘Why,’ and so forth. Maharshal deletes Ammi, and he is right.
